Brv_churchman_default2.m: Sorry, I haven't seen anyone like that.

brv_churchman.m: Hello. I am Seviron. You are not supposed to be up here.
r: What is this room used for?
I'm looking for my brother, Andor. He looks a bit like me. Have you seen him?

brv_churchman_01.m: This is the church bell tower.

brv_churchman_01a.m: No. Irritating children do not usually come up here. You are an exception.
r: Hmm. OK. What is this room?

brv_churchman_02.m: We use the bells to both notify townsfolk when there is a service, and to warn of danger to the town.

brv_churchman_03.m: I am the bell-ringer. Unfortunately, I also have to guard the bells from Quasi. He likes to ring them even when there is no reason to do so.
r: OK. Thanks. I'm looking for my brother, Andor. Have you seen him?

brv_churchman_04a.m: Quasi is the grave digger. He is usually in the basement. Sometimes he is trouble, but mostly he is useful. Anyway, he has nowhere else to go, so he lives in the church.

brv_churchman_04b.m:
Yes, that is one way to put it. 	
He is useful, so he lives here in the church. He has nowhere else to go anyway, so we accommodate him.

brv_churchman_05.m: Is there anything else I can help you with? You are distracting me from watching the cat and the mouse on the other side of the room.

brv_churchman_06.m: The mice like to chew the bell rope, which is a problem. So we brought in the cat to control them. That particular mouse seems to be very good at evading the cat though. It knows just when to turn, and just where to hide where the cat cannot reach it. If the cat cannot get rid of it, I will have to think of something else.
r: Can I help in some way?
I need to find my brother. Bye.
Good luck with that! I have more important things to deal with. Bye.

brv_churchman_07.m: You could help me trap it. I need some cheese, a large empty bottle, and some rocks that we can use to prop up the bottle at an angle. If the mouse crawls in to get the cheese, it will not be able to get out again.
r: Sorry. I don't have time for that. I have to go.

brv_churchman_08.m: Thanks. Just bring me the items. I think three rocks should be enough.
r: I have the rocks and the cheese.
I'll go and get the items you asked for.

brv_churchman_09a.m: Thanks. Now we just need the cheese and the bottle.

brv_churchman_09b.m: Thanks. Now we just need the rocks and the bottle.

brv_churchman_09c.m: Thanks. Now we just need the bottle. You should ask around town. Someone must have one.

r: No, not yet. I'm still looking for one.

brv_churchman_b2.m: Excellent. I'll set the trap. This will require some patience though, so you should come back later to see if it worked.

brv_churchman_default1.m: Hello again. Is there something I can help you with?
r: I'm looking for my brother, Andor. He looks a bit like me.

brv_churchman_i1.m: Do you have the items we need for the trap?
r: I have the rocks and the cheese.

brv_churchman_mouse1.m: What do you intend to do with the mouse?
r: I'll give it to the cat. That should solve the problem.

brv_churchman_trap2.m: We caught the mouse! Here it is, in the bottle. You can decide what to do with it. And here's a little gold for your help.
r: I'll give it to the cat. That should solve the problem!

brv_churchman_trap3.m: Sorry, the mouse is still running around. We will get it though. Be patient.

brv_churchman_trap3a.m: Hmm. I'm sure the cat will be happy, but I doubt the mouse will!

brv_churchman_trap3b.m: Well, don't release it in the town. It will just go into another building.

cat_and_mouse.10: I agreed to help Seviron trap the mouse that the cat cannot catch. I need to get some cheese, a large empty bottle, and three rocks.
cat_and_mouse.20: I have given Seviron the rocks.
cat_and_mouse.30: I have given Seviron the cheese.
cat_and_mouse.40: I obtained a suitable bottle from Arlish.
cat_and_mouse.50: I have given Seviron the bottle. Seviron will set the trap, but it may take some time to catch the mouse. I should come back later.
cat_and_mouse.60: The mouse has been caught! Seviron gave it to me in the bottle. He said I can decide what to do with it.
cat_and_mouse.70: I decided to give the mouse to the cat. The cat would have eventually killed it anyway.
cat_and_mouse.80: I decided to release the mouse outside. Seviron told me to do that outside the town.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
